title: Accuracy Sentinel Automation for Adaptive Calibration
creator: Aisha Kumar
description:
Goal: Build an automated accuracy validation harness (the Accuracy Sentinel) that runs during calibration and CI for FP8/INT8 profile rollouts. The harness must: 1) maintain a curated and evolving golden prompt corpus (seeded from existing golden sets + production signal clustering), 2) compute a multi-metric fidelity score per model/profile (token agreement, logit-diff distribution, embedding drift, and task-specific metrics), 3) enforce pass/fail gates with automated remediation (fallback to higher-precision model variant or quarantine for manual review), and 4) integrate with runtime canary pipelines and the Console for observability.

Scope & deliverables:
- Golden prompt manager service (CLI + API) that supports deterministic seeding, stratified sampling by length/domain, and adversarial perturbation generation.
- Scoring pipeline that outputs a single composite fidelity score and a breakdown of sub-metrics, along with confidence intervals and drift alarms.
- Gate definitions: baseline-relative thresholds, asymmetric tolerances for tail behaviour, and paired-statistical tests to avoid flapping on small samples.
- CI/CD integration: GitHub Actions job and an internal canary job that triggers the harness against candidate quant profiles before autoscaling them into Dedicated pools.
- Console dashboards and alerting: per-profile trend charts, rollback suggestion, and per-prompt failure inspector.

Trade-offs discussed:
- Goldens curation frequency vs. stability: decided to re-curate monthly with emergency ad-hoc runs when production drift exceeds threshold to avoid label noise.
- Composite score design: weighting token-agreement higher for safety-critical prompts, embedding drift higher for semantic tasks. We will make weights configurable per project in the manager service.
- Statistical tests: use paired bootstrap for metric CI instead of parametric tests because of heavy-tailed logit differences observed in earlier runs.

Non-goals (for this ticket): automated retraining or model update pipelines; on-device quant checks.

Data sensitivity: Golden set may include customer-like examples. All stored goldens must be access-restricted and encrypted with KMS keys. See security checklist in Confluence (link below).
acceptance_criteria: Golden prompt manager can ingest seed lists and produce stratified test shards deterministically
Scoring pipeline produces composite score and per-metric breakdown with 95% CI
A pass/fail gate config can be declared in a profile YAML and is enforced by CI with documented rollback behavior
Canary run succeeds end-to-end in GitHub Actions and blocks merge on failure
Console shows per-profile historical fidelity and flags failing prompts with exact diff snapshots
